INSERT INTO knowledge_bases(id,name,tenant_id,embedding_model_id,summary_model_id,type,chunking_config,indexing_strategy)SELECT 'portal-new-kb','New KB after Portal publication',tenant_id,embedding_model_id,summary_model_id,type,chunking_config,indexing_strategy FROM knowledge_bases WHERE id='future-private'

INSERT INTO knowledges SELECT(jsonb_populate_record(NULL::knowledges,to_jsonb(k)||jsonb_build_object('id','portal-new-doc','knowledge_base_id','portal-new-kb','title','PORTALNEWCANARY'))).* FROM knowledges k WHERE id='future-private-doc'

INSERT INTO chunks SELECT(jsonb_populate_record(NULL::chunks,to_jsonb(c)||jsonb_build_object('id','portal-new-chunk','knowledge_id','portal-new-doc','knowledge_base_id','portal-new-kb','content','PORTALNEWCANARY'))).* FROM chunks c WHERE id='future-private-chunk'
